parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value must be unique across different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: rolename
parameters.description:
The name of the service-linked role. Valid values:

<props="china">- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchOps: used to perform elastic scaling tasks for clusters</props>- AliyunServiceRoleForElasticsearchCollector: used to create and manage Beats collectors
